name: Ecuador
description: Ecuador from Valdivia pottery and the Inca north to Spanish Quito, independence, the Galápagos and today.

checkpoints.name: Before the Incas
checkpoints.note: The Valdivia people made some of the first pottery of the Americas. Many peoples lived on the coast and in the highlands.

checkpoints.name: Incas and Spain
checkpoints.note: The Incas conquered the land in the late 1400s. Spain took it in the 1530s and ruled from Quito.

checkpoints.name: Republic
checkpoints.note: Quito rose in 1809, Sucre won at Pichincha in 1822, and Ecuador left Gran Colombia in 1830.
